abstract: This paper develops an information-theoretic framework that integrates the principle of minimum relative entropy with Bellman’s principle of optimality to formally characterize how purposeful individual behavior gives rise to spontaneous order in market economies. Under standard assumptions from dynamic programming theory, I prove that a probabilistic formulation of Bellman’s equation, subject to an upper bound on relative entropy, admits a unique solution in the form of a dynamic logit function. This function generates a Markov transition with a unique invariant probability distribution, which characterizes economic equilibria as emergent outcomes arising from the purposeful behavior of private agents. I apply these results to neoclassical models of consumption and investment, illustrating that the theory can effectively account for key cross-sectional and time-series properties of economic systems.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息论框架，将最小相对熵原理与贝尔曼最优性原则相结合，以正式刻画有目的性的个体行为如何在市场经济中催生自发秩序。在动态规划理论的标准假设下，我证明了在相对熵上界约束下的贝尔曼方程的概率形式化表述，具有唯一解，该解表现为动态逻辑函数形式。此函数生成一个具有唯一不变概率分布的马尔可夫转移，从而将经济均衡刻画为私人主体有目的性行为涌现出的结果。我将这些结果应用于新古典消费与投资模型，说明该理论能有效解释经济系统中的关键横截面与时间序列特征。
title: A theory of probabilistic economic equilibria

abstract: We study infinite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with fast–slow structure, in which some state variables evolve rapidly (fast states), whereas others change more gradually (slow states). This structure commonly arises in practice when decisions must be made at high frequencies over long horizons and when slowly changing information still plays a critical role in determining optimal actions. Examples include inventory control under slowly changing demand indicators or dynamic pricing with gradually shifting consumer behavior. Modeling the problem at the natural decision frequency leads to MDPs with discount factors close to one, making them computationally challenging. We propose a novel approximation strategy that freezes slow states during phases of lower level planning and subsequently applies value iteration to an auxiliary upper level MDP that evolves on a slower timescale. Freezing states for short periods of time leads to easier to solve lower level problems, whereas a slower upper level timescale allows for a more favorable discount factor. On the theoretical side, we analyze the regret incurred by our frozen-state approach, and this leads to simple insights on how to trade off regret versus computational cost. Empirically, we benchmark our new frozen-state methods on three domains: (i) inventory control with fixed order costs, (ii) a grid world problem with spatial tasks, and (iii) dynamic pricing with reference price effects. We demonstrate that the new methods produce high-quality policies with significantly less computation, and we show that simply omitting slow states is often a poor heuristic. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: This research is based upon work supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation [Grant 1807536]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00012 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Frozen-State Value Iteration: Faster Reinforcement Learning by Freezing Slow States

abstract: The 1430s were characterized by extreme weather conditions, food and fodder shortages, and high mortalities among animals and humans, although the severity of events and their consequences in England have received limited attention. The economic downturn and the depressed customary land market in this decade marked the beginning of the Great Slump, which lasted until at least the 1460s. Evidence is drawn from across England to sketch the anatomy of the crisis, followed by consideration of its impact on tenurial change. Various devices adopted in the 1430s to retain or attract tenants gained traction over the next three decades. Some lords opted to alienate sections of their demesnes permanently into the peasant sector on customary tenure; the practice of leasing customary land diminished; grants of land for money tenure held heritably or for lives now became the dominant form of customary tenure; and the issue of copies of unfree land transfers became widespread. These changes were decisive in preventing any return to direct demesne management and the traditional servile tenures based on labour services and uncertain dues, and created the essential preconditions for the emergence of copyhold tenure.
abstract_zh: 1430年代以极端天气条件、食物和饲料短缺以及动物和人类高死亡率为特征，尽管这些事件及其后果在英格兰的严重性受到的关注有限。这十年的经济衰退和习惯土地市场的低迷标志着大萧条的起始，该萧条持续至至少1460年代。证据来自英格兰各地，用以勾勒危机的轮廓，随后考虑其对保有形式变化的影响。1430年代为保留或吸引佃户而采取的各种措施在接下来的三十年间逐渐获得势头。一些领主选择将其直营地部分永久转让给农民部门，以习惯保有形式持有；习惯土地的租赁做法减少；以金钱保有形式授予土地，可继承或终身持有的赠予，如今成为习惯保有土地的主要形式；非自由土地转让副本的发放变得普遍。这些变化在防止回归直接直营地管理和基于劳役及不确定费用的传统农奴保有方面起到了决定性作用，并为公簿保有权的出现创造了必要的先决条件。
title: Extreme weather and economic crisis in the 1430s in England, and the implications for tenurial change
title_zh: 1430年代英格兰极端天气与经济危机及其对土地保有制度变革的影响

abstract: Lobbying transparency regulations are hailed as a potential solution to concerns about the excessive influence of special interest groups (SIGs) over policymaking. I study how these regulations shape strategic interactions between voters, politicians and SIGs. By clarifying the process through which a policy was implemented, lobbying transparency helps voters hold politicians accountable and control the influence of SIGs. Ex-post, conditional on access, SIGs prefer to operate without lobbying transparency. Ex-ante, they may benefit from lobbying transparency because it redirects the voters’ blame towards politicians. However, lobbying transparency standards may ultimately hurt the electoral prospects of politicians and thus risk never being implemented, potentially explaining why voters’ demand for it remains unanswered.
abstract_zh: 游说透明度法规被视为解决特殊利益集团（SIGs）对政策制定过度影响担忧的潜在方案。我研究了这些法规如何塑造选民、政治家和特殊利益集团之间的策略互动。通过明确政策实施的过程，游说透明度有助于选民追究政治家的责任，并控制特殊利益集团的影响力。事后，在获得准入的条件下，特殊利益集团倾向于在没有游说透明度的情况下运作。事前，他们可能因游说透明度而受益，因为它将选民的指责转向政治家。然而，游说透明度标准最终可能损害政治家的选举前景，从而面临永远无法实施的风险，这或许解释了为何选民对此的需求始终未得到回应。
title: The case for lobbying transparency
